title: Dedicated autoscaler: smoother burst controls, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting (v45)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers running Dedicated fleets have reported occasional oscillations when burst allowances are consumed rapidly (spikes followed by over-compensation), and SRE teams need clearer per-fleet utilization and throughput guarantees to validate SLA adherence. This PR implements a smoothing policy for token-bucket based burst controls, tighter throughput-guarantee enforcement at the fleet level, and expanded utilization reporting to help operators correlate burst events with autoscaler decisions. Changes are designed to be opt-in via controller feature flags and gradual rollout via canary fleets. Summary of changes: 1) autoscaler: introduce tokenbucket smoothing window and adaptive restore-rate based on recent effective throughput; 2) scheduler: enforce throughput guarantees by reserving capacity headroom for guaranteed routes and accounting for burst credits; 3) telemetry: publish per-fleet burst_credit_history, smoothed_token_rate, and guaranteed_throughput_reserved metrics; 4) API/console: expose new per-fleet SLO dashboard panels and a diagnostic endpoint for burst-credit timelines; 5) tests: add unit and integration tests that simulate realistic burst patterns and validate smooth degradation/fallback. Linear/JIRA: references ENG-2169, ENG-2170, SUP-1298. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2169) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Telemetry dashboards updated - [x] Feature-flag gated + rollout plan included Rollout plan: enable smoothing=false by default; enable smoothing=true for 5% of fleets for 24h; monitor smoothed_token_rate and queueing_latency alarms; expand to 25% then 100% if metrics stable. Backwards compatibility: all new behavior is behind a feature flag and does not change existing token-bucket default parameters unless enabled.
commits_summary: Initial smoothing poli cy + tests; fix: edge case when restore-rate drops to zero; telemetry: add smoothed_token_rate metric and labels; scheduler: reserve headroom for throughput guarantees; docs: console panels + API docs; ci: test flake fix for simulated timeouts
review_comments: Samir Gupta: Nice design. Two questions: (1) how does smoothing interact with priority routing — will high-priority routes still preempt burst credits? (answered) We ensure reserved headroom for guaranteed routes and only smooth leftover credits.

Lena Chen: CI caught a flake in the integration test harness on the first run — looks like a timing issue in the fake clock; please add a deterministic waiter. (author reply) Added explicit barrier and extended test harness timeout — reran and passed.

Rajiv Kumar: Can we add an alert that fires if smoothed_token_rate diverges from raw_token_rate by >x% for >5m? (author reply) Added new alert smoothed_vs_raw_token_rate_delta and documented threshold as a tuning parameter in the rollout notes.
ci_details: CI run #1: unit tests pass, integration tests flaky (timeout) -> fix applied; CI run #2: all checks pass; e2e smoke in canary environment passed
release_notes: - Introduces token-bucket smoothing for Dedicated autoscaler to reduce oscillations during burst consumption. - Adds throughput reservation to enforce per-route throughput guarantees on Dedicated fleets. - Exposes smoothed_token_rate and burst_credit_history metrics for improved observability. - Feature-flag gated; rollout plan included in PR.
notes: Ops: enable feature flag 'dedicated.autoscaler.smoothing' in values.yaml for canary fleets. Monitor metrics/alerts added in telemetry. Documentation page updated at docs/observability/fleet-burst-credits.md.
